SELECT b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.flight_id,b.passenger_id,b.amount_cents,b.status,b.client_reference,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.state,c.created_step,ce.event_id AS cancellation,ce.step AS cancel_step FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events ce ON ce.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status='pending' OR ce.event_id IS NOT NULL
